mapper.sql: CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(d.product_model), '') IS NOT NULL THEN d.product_model ELSE (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(product.product_model), '') FROM ast_product_official_info product WHERE product.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND product.deleted = 0 AND product.product_code = TRIM(d.product_code) AND NULLIF(TRIM(d.product_code), '') IS NOT NULL) END
